name: Hyperlinks
description: A collection of all the Hyperlink objects on a slide or master.
example:
For Each hl In ActivePresentation.Slides(1).Hyperlinks

    If hl.Address = "c:\current work\sales.ppt" Then

        hl.Address = "c:\new\newsales.ppt"

    End If

Next

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the specified collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a single Hyperlink object from the specified Hyperlinks collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The index number of the single Hyperlink object in the collection to be returned.
